mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_materials ( user_id, original_filename, stored_filename, storage_path, content_type, size_bytes, page_count, file_hash, extraction_status, extracted_text, extraction_error, extraction_warning, document_title, document_title_read, source_archive_name, source_entry_path, origin, source_conversation_id, original_expires_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{originalFilename}, #{storedFilename}, #{storagePath}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{pageCount}, #{fileHash}, #{extractionStatus}, #{extractedText}, #{extractionError}, #{extractionWarning}, #{documentTitle}, #{documentTitleRead}, #{sourceArchiveName}, #{sourceEntryPath}, #{origin}, #{sourceConversationId}, #{originalExpiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_materials WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.sql: material_id, user_id, original_filename, stored_filename, storage_path, content_type, size_bytes, page_count, file_hash, extraction_status, NULL AS extracted_text, extraction_error, extraction_warning, document_title, document_title_read, source_archive_name, source_entry_path, status, origin, source_conversation_id, original_expires_at, original_removed_at, original_removed_reason, original_purged_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course_materials WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT material_id FROM course_materials WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND extracted_text IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(extracted_text)) > 0

SELECT cm.* FROM course_materials cm JOIN material_links l ON l.material_id = cm.material_id AND l.course_id = #{courseId} WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM course_materials WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM course_materials WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND material_id IN #{id} ORDER BY material_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update:
UPDATE course_materials SET status = 'DELETED', extracted_text = NULL,
original_removed_at = IF(origin IS NULL, original_removed_at, COALESCE(original_removed_at, NOW())), original_removed_reason = IF(origin IS NULL, original_removed_reason, COALESCE(original_removed_reason, 'USER')) WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course_materials WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source_conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND origin = 'CONSULT_PHOTO' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY material_id
SELECT FROM course_materials WHERE origin = 'CONSULT_PHOTO' AND original_purged_at IS NULL AND original_removed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY material_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE course_materials SET original_purged_at = #{now} WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND original_purged_at IS NULL

UPDATE course_materials SET extraction_status = #{extractionStatus}, extracted_text = #{extractedText}, extraction_error = #{extractionError}, extraction_warning = #{extractionWarning}, page_count = #{pageCount}, document_title = #{documentTitle}, document_title_read = 1 WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE course_materials SET document_title = #{documentTitle}, document_title_read = 1 WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND document_title_read = 0
UPDATE course_materials SET page_count = #{pageCount} WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT cm.* FROM course_materials cm WHERE cm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cm.extraction_status = 'SUCCESS' AND cm.origin IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM material_analysis_jobs j WHERE j.material_id = cm.material_id AND j.job_kind = 'CONTENT' AND j.course_id = 0 AND j.analysis_version = #{analysisVersion} AND (cm.file_hash IS NULL OR j.file_hash = cm.file_hash)) ORDER BY cm.material_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE course_materials SET file_hash = #{fileHash} WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND file_hash IS NULL
